context_for_next_testing_agent: The journey logic refactor is complete. Key changes: 1) recruiting_status and reply_status fields still exist in DB but are NOT used for UI logic or board grouping anymore. 2) New 'signals' object computed from interactions collection determines board grouping. 3) Active/Inactive toggle replaces manual status dropdowns on Journey page. 4) Mark as Replied button appears when outreach sent but no coach reply detected. 5) Board groups are: action_required (no activity/overdue), upcoming (due within 14 days), in_progress (coach reply OR recently contacted within 7 days), closed (is_active=false).

data_driven_signals.compute_interaction_signals(): Computes emails_sent, has_coach_reply, last_outreach_date, days_since_outreach, total_interactions from interactions collection
data_driven_signals.categorize_program(): Uses signals + is_active + next_action_due to determine board group

board_grouping_logic.action_required: Default - no activity, overdue, or stale
board_grouping_logic.in_progress: has_coach_reply=true OR days_since_outreach <= 7 (recently contacted), not overdue

journey_page_changes.active_toggle: STATUS shows Active/Inactive pill toggle instead of recruiting_status dropdown
journey_page_changes.mark_as_replied: Button appears in NextStepHero when outreach sent but no reply
journey_page_changes.mark_as_replied_modal: Opens with note field, creates coach_reply interaction

board_page_changes.group_funnel: Shows data-driven counts for all 4 groups
board_page_changes.program_row: Shows data-driven Next Step based on signals
board_page_changes.journey_button: Navigates to Journey page for each program
